games.title: Pressure Grid
games.blurb: Pump pressure into cells, siphon it toward neighbors, and ride the chain reactions when cells erupt.

mechanics.name: pump
mechanics.description: Tap a cell to add pressure to it.

mechanics.name: siphon
mechanics.description: Drag from a cell to move a fraction of its pressure into the neighbor you dragged toward, losing some to inefficiency.

games.sharedState: Pressure per cell: written by pump and siphon, read by siphon and by the passive bleed-and-eruption system.
games.goal: Sandbox, with no win condition. Chase the achievements.

achievements.title: Chain Reaction
achievements.description: Set off 5 or more eruptions at once.

achievements.title: Siphon Strike
achievements.description: Cause an eruption with a siphon.

achievements.title: Full Pressure
achievements.description: Get every cell on the board to 20+ pressure at once.

games.title: Orbit Garden
games.blurb: Place planets, fling seeds around them, and grow a garden in orbit. Every seed that lands makes its planet pull harder.
games.goal: Get 3 planets blooming at the same time before your 40 seeds run out.

mechanics.name: place
mechanics.description: Tap the sky to add a small planet (a gravity well).

mechanics.name: fling
mechanics.description: Drag to launch a seed from the launcher; it curves around planets and adds mass to the one it lands on.

games.sharedState: Planet mass: placing creates it, landed seeds add to it, and it sets how hard each planet pulls on every seed. A passive wither drains it, and blooming is read from it.

achievements.title: First Bloom
achievements.description: Grow a planet until it blooms.

achievements.title: Frugal Gardener
achievements.description: Complete a garden with 15 or more seeds left.

achievements.title: Gravity Assist
achievements.description: Land a seed that swung more than 90° away from where you flung it.

achievements.title: Green Thumb
achievements.description: Land 5 seeds in a row without a miss.

achievements.title: Full Sky
achievements.description: Have 5 planets in the sky at once.
